name: Offbeat Kashmir Winter Tour
route: Srinagar · Awantipora · Kokernag · Achabal · Tangmarg or Gulmarg · old city
description: A seven-day winter route through the southern springs, Kokernag, Achabal and Srinagar, with a flexible mountain outing.

itinerary.title: Settle into Srinagar
itinerary.description: Begin with a light arrival day, a warm drink and time to discuss the winter route. A short lakefront outing can fit an early arrival; otherwise keep the evening close to your stay.
experiences: A gentle arrival and route briefing
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: South towards the springs
itinerary.description: Travel south with one heritage pause at Awantipora if opening and daylight allow. Continue to a selected Kokernag-area stay. Winter heating and road access need checking before choosing this overnight base.
experiences: A heritage pause on the onward route
An early arrival at the southern-valley base
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Gardens and a slower winter day
itinerary.description: Keep a focused day around Kokernag and, when roads allow, the Verinag spring. Choose shorter walks and warm breaks. Daksum can replace part of the programme only after a local access check; it is not a compulsory winter detour.
experiences: An optional Daksum substitution after local advice
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Achabal and the road back
itinerary.description: Return through Achabal when the garden and approach are accessible, keeping enough daylight for Srinagar. Skip a stop if weather slows the drive rather than extending the transfer into a late-night road day.
experiences: A spring-garden stop on the selected route
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: A snow-country day on request
itinerary.description: Choose Tangmarg or a lower Gulmarg outing according to the road conditions. Snow-chain or local vehicle arrangements and any Gondola tickets are identified separately in the quote. A Srinagar-based alternative is available to discuss if the mountain road is unsuitable.
experiences: A city alternative when access changes
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Old Srinagar and living craft
itinerary.description: Give the city its own day. Choose a focused Jhelum-side walk around Khanqah-e-Moula and one market area, or an appointed Bait-ul-Meeras and artisan visit. Keep worship access, opening arrangements and indoor breaks central to the plan.
experiences: One appointed craft demonstration, without shopping pressure
itinerary.pace: Time for travel, short walks and warm indoor breaks
itinerary.routeNote: Winter routes are adapted to road and weather conditions. Optional tickets and local vehicles are confirmed in your quote.

itinerary.title: Departure from the valley
itinerary.description: Arrange your transfer around the flight and protect a generous road buffer. Extra sightseeing is considered only when departure timing allows.
